topic: Keeping an entry: high card from the short hand first
why: South opens 1NT with 17 points and North, with six hearts, raises to 3NT.
West leads the ♠Q. Count your tricks: the ♠A-K, the ♦A and six hearts if they break 3-2 make nine. But dummy has no way in outside hearts, and your ♥A is in the way.

Win the ♠A and cash the ♥A first: the high card from the short hand. Then lead the ♥8 to dummy's jack. You are in dummy with the ♥K-Q-6-4 still to come, and the defenders' last heart falls under the king. Run the hearts, then come back to your hand for the ♠K and ♦A: nine tricks.
Lead the ♥8 to the king first, and when you play the next heart your ace has to win it. You are stuck in your hand and dummy's last four hearts never score: three down.
title: Keeping an entry

hints.1: Count your tricks. Once the hearts are good, how will you get to dummy to cash them?
hints.2: You have only two hearts, and one of them is the ace. Which should you play first, so that you finish in dummy?
hints.default: Play the high card from the short hand first: cash your ♥A, then lead your small heart to dummy.

traps.msg: If you lead the 8 first, your ♥A will have to win a later round and you will be stuck in your hand, with dummy's hearts stranded. Cash the ♥A first, then lead the 8 to dummy.

page.count: Nine tricks: the ♠A-K, the ♦A and six hearts, if you can reach them.
page.clue: North raised to 3NT with a long suit and nothing else: dummy's only way in is the hearts.
page.danger: Your ♥A can block the suit and strand dummy's winners.
page.plan: Cash the ♥A first, then lead your small heart to dummy and run the suit.

questions.q: How many tricks can the hearts give you?
questions.hint: Dummy has six hearts and the defenders have five.
questions.explain: If they break 3-2, all six of dummy's hearts are winners.

questions.q: How else can you reach dummy?
questions.explain: Dummy has no ace or king outside hearts.

questions.hint: Where will you be after the ace wins?
questions.explain: If the ace wins a later round, you are in your hand with dummy's hearts cut off.

questions.q: Which heart do you play first?
questions.hint: Which hand is short in hearts?
questions.explain: Play the high card from the short hand first.

questions.q: After the ♥A, how do you go on?
questions.hint: Where do you want to be when the hearts are good?
questions.explain: You finish in dummy with the rest of the hearts to run.

replay: West leads the ♠Q; win the ace.
High card from the short hand first: the ♥A.
Now the defence take the rest.
